hooks.prompt: Check if the file that was just written/edited is an Ansible file (path contains 'ansible/' and ends with .yml or .yaml). If YES: Run ansible-lint on that specific file using: cd $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR && uv run ansible-lint <file_path> 2>&1 || true. Report any ERROR-level issues (not warnings). If NO errors or file is not an Ansible file: respond with just 'Validated' or 'Skipped (not Ansible)'. Keep response under 50 words unless reporting errors.
